japanese.question: Can you translate Japanese manga?
japanese.answer: Yes. We support automatic recognition and translation of Japanese manga while preserving speech-bubble layout and art style.

korean.question: Can you translate Korean manhwa?
korean.answer: Yes. We support vertically read Korean comics and common webtoon layouts.

chinese.question: Can you translate Chinese manga?
chinese.answer: Yes. We support cross-language translation of Simplified and Traditional Chinese comics.

ai.question: What AI do you use?
ai.answer: We use a multi-model pipeline optimized for manga, covering text detection, translation, and inpainting.

duration.question: How long does translation take?
duration.answer: A single page usually takes a few seconds to tens of seconds, depending on image size and queue load.

formats.question: Which formats are supported?
formats.answer: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC, PDF, EPUB, CBZ, and ZIP.

expiry.question: Do credits expire?
expiry.answer: Pay Per Use credits never expire. Subscription credits refresh each billing cycle.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: We support 20+ languages, including Japanese, Chinese, English, Korean, and other common manga languages.

privacy.question: Is my data safe?
privacy.answer: Uploaded content is used only for translation. It is not used for public training or shared with others.

refund.question: How do refunds work?
refund.answer: Unused paid credits can be refunded according to our policy. See the terms of service for details.

plugin.question: Is there a browser extension?
plugin.answer: A browser extension is coming soon. For now, please upload and translate on the web app.
